customSections.title: 🎨 Design Principles & Patterns
customSections.html:
📱 Read-Only Focus

Focused on display/design, no editing. Data stored in JSON. React/MUI with color themes.

🌗 Theme Support

Light and dark mode toggle. Default theme colors. Expanse component addons.

📦 Collapsible Sections

Prefer collapsible sections with settings for each section that can be edited component by component.

🎨 Color Philosophy

Design for black and white first. Use monochrome with variations in opacity/vibrance. Less vibrancy, lighter colors.

🔤 MUI Icons

Utilize MUI icons for displaying content. Symbol/icon review pipeline for adding visual cues.

🏷️ Chips & Tokens

Concise variants, tokens, token chips for categorical details. Chip color design considerations.

customSections.title: 🖥️ UI Patterns & Features
customSections.html:
📋 Content Blocks
Content blocks + suggestions with clicks. Blocks converted to pages/slides.
🎬 Presentation Mode
Card design enables step-by-step improvement, converts to slideshow easily.
📊 Multiple Views
Accordion, tabs, stepper/wizard flow, visuals. Generate samples, choose or use recommended.
🔘 Command Options
More slides, break it down, expand it, clarify, accuracy validation.
🎯 Feedback Options
Content options like TikTok style. Interactive feedback loops.
🎨 Preset Templates
Preset template styles. Maybe everything is a slide?

customSections.title: 🤖 AI Guidance & Working Patterns
customSections.html:
🧠 Working with AI

Continue working with it. Tips for working with AI, especially if AI returns a response that disagrees with the user. Can also ask AI to respond with tips and recommended actions generally.

⚠️ Problems to Avoid

  • Some context removed (sensitive info)
  • Some errors in generation
  • Avoiding complexity, keep simple
  • Focus on individual components

✅ Best Practices

  • Save progression of code and chat
  • Multiple content review cycles
  • Human collaboration for review
  • Centralize content in JSON with TypeScript

customSections.title: 🎯 Personalization Concept
customSections.html:
🧠 Per-Student Content Generation

Content generated for each learning style and level. Able to have different default content for each student based on their profiles and learning styles. Can be custom or anonymous. Generate multiple views and play with it (accordion, tabs, stepper/wizard, visuals). Generate sample components to choose from or use recommended. Display options for improvement via previously discovered options.
